title: Production Lead Engine
audience: Developers and agencies needing durable scale, controlled concurrency, multiple campaigns, and stronger auditability.
shortDescription: Build a database-backed lead automation application with TypeScript, PostgreSQL, durable jobs, workers, and production controls.
coreOutcome: When a workflow is no longer enough, build the system as software.
problem: Workflow automation becomes difficult to govern when campaigns, concurrency, auditability, and recovery requirements grow.
situation: A proven automated pipeline now needs durable state, explicit job policies, provider boundaries, and operational controls.
commonFailure: Stretching a workflow tool into an application obscures state, recovery, testing, and ownership boundaries.
methodology: Model the system around PostgreSQL records, durable queue jobs, workers, provider adapters, webhooks, observability, and tests.
capabilities: Test, deploy, and operate the application
whoItsFor: Advanced developers and agencies with production requirements
whoItsNotFor: Buyers whose needs are met by a supervised or n8n-based workflow
stateModel: PostgreSQL is system of record; queue job is the unit of execution
supervision: Production monitoring, maintenance, and exception operations
technicalBoundary: Workers and services orchestrate; database and queue policies own retries and dedupe.
